newsitem.title: USA: AirTouch, U S West shrs firm on deal.
newsitem.headline: AirTouch, U S West shrs firm on deal.

text.p: Shares in AirTouch Communications Inc and U S West Media Group traded moderately higher Friday after announcing AirTouch's agreement to acquire U S West's wireless communication operations in a deal worth about $5 billion.
In late morning trade, AirTouch shares were up 7/8, or 3.7 percent, to 24-3/8 while U S West Media added 1/2, or 2.9 percent, to 17-3/4.
The $5 billion price includes assumption of $2.2 billion of debt by AirTouch and the tax-free distribution of AirTouch stock to U S Media Group shareholders, they said.

The deal, now contained in a letter of intent and subject to execution of a definitive agreement, specifically calls for U S WEST Media to merge NewVector, its domestic cellular business, and its interest in PrimeCo Personal Communications into AirTouch.
The number of AirTouch shares to be issued will vary depending on their trading price, they said.

Larry Petrella, Lehman Bros analyst, said in a research note that based on terms of the deal "the U S West Media Group share price would adjust from the $17-1/4 level to around $13-3/4 per share with each U S West shareholder directly receiving approximately $3-1/2 in value per UMG share of AirTouch stock."
He noted the proposed deal would be tax-free, reduce debt and leave the Media Group with a simpler operating strucuture.
The analyst said he maintains is buy rating on U S West Media Group.
